description: Resolve a company or organization name to its Tensorust Ontology card: legal entity or control group, data sources, linked objects by type (homes owned, control group members, subsidiaries, FCC licenses, federal awards, E-Rate requests) and the federal rules that apply to it, with status. Free: counts and previews. full=true: every linked object and property with a Tensorust key.

full.description: true returns every linked object and property. Needs a Tensorust key (Authorization: Bearer tdk_...). Omit for the free preview.
